title: Community Based Violence Intervention and Prevention Initiative Implementation Checklist (April 2022)
publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance
use_for: A six-step checklist for planning, staffing, measuring and sustaining a CVI program, from community assessment to sustainability.

title: Community Violence Intervention (topic page and CVIPI resources)
publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Justice Programs
use_for: Federal CVI definitions, the online implementation checklist, a CVI glossary and links to federal funding information.

title: Community Violence Intervention Action Plan
publisher: Community Justice, the Health Alliance for Violence Intervention and the National Institute for Criminal Justice Reform
use_for: A community-led national blueprint for the CVI field, useful for aligning your own strategy and standards with the wider movement.

title: Actionable Resources for Change in Violence Intervention (ARCvi)
use_for: A free hub of FAQs, quick guides, templates and trainings that help CVI programs plan, use data and strengthen practice.

title: ARCvi: The Evidence
use_for: Plain-language research guides, evaluation vocabulary and study summaries on what works in CVI, for whom and under what conditions.

title: ARCvi: Using Data That Matters
use_for: Templates, tools and trainings for setting up data collection, performance measures and data-driven program management.

title: ARCvi: Finding and Sustaining Funding
use_for: Guidance on funding types, grant-writing capacity and building a more diversified, sustainable funding portfolio.

title: ARCvi: Supporting the Frontline
use_for: Resources, trainings and academies that support and professionalize credible messengers and other frontline staff.

title: ARCvi: Working Together
use_for: Resources on partnerships, referral networks, coalitions and coordinating services across a local CVI ecosystem.

title: Hospital-Based Violence Intervention Programs: A Guide to Implementation and Costing (2024)
publisher: Everytown for Gun Safety Support Fund and the Health Alliance for Violence Intervention
use_for: A guide and customizable costing tool for budgeting the full cost of a program, including supervision, operations and indirect costs.

title: The Health Alliance for Violence Intervention (The HAVI)
publisher: The Health Alliance for Violence Intervention
use_for: A national peer learning network for hospital and community violence intervention programs to share models and training.

title: Everytown Community Safety Fund
use_for: Background on the Community Safety Fund, how it supports community-based violence intervention and what CVI means to the Fund.

title: Community Safety Fund grantees: viewpoints and articles
use_for: Stories and viewpoints from peer CVI organizations, useful for learning from peers and for shaping your own storytelling.

title: Community Violence Prevention Resource for Action (2024)
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
use_for: Prevention strategies with the best available evidence, useful when choosing complementary programs and writing a theory of change.

title: Community Violence Intervention Leadership Academy (CVILA)
use_for: A leadership and management training program for CVI leaders covering supervision, operations and organizational growth.

title: Governance and Related Topics: 501(c)(3) Organizations
use_for: Plain guidance on board duties, mission, key policies (such as conflict of interest), financial statements and Form 990 transparency.

title: Cyber Guidance for Small Businesses
use_for: Step-by-step basics for protecting a small team's accounts, devices and data from common cyber threats such as ransomware.

title: Hospital-based violence intervention programs in the United States and Canada: systematic review, meta-analysis and EAST practice guideline (2026)
publisher: Journal of Trauma and Acute Care Surgery (Jawa et al.)
use_for: Current evidence that program intensity, engagement, trained staff and community ties shape results, plus priorities for data elements.

title: Medicaid reimbursement for community violence intervention and prevention: a multi-state policy implementation case study (2025)
use_for: How states set up Medicaid reimbursement for CVI services, including certification, billing and documentation needs.
